title: One for the Money
contentHtml: I just took a walk down to the local shoe store and fell in love.

title: Two for the Show
contentHtml: I had never seen a pair of shoes quite so beautiful and I had to have them.

title: Three to Get Ready
contentHtml: I ran home, took what savings I had, ran back to the store, and bought those shoes.

title: Go Cat Go!
contentHtml: I want to keep them nice, so don't you step on my blue suede shoes!
